materials.content:
[1] Hot Cross Bun Breathalyser reading claim out to the test

[2] Heather Jones produced a video that showed how one bite of a hot cross bun could get you in trouble with police. The video has been viewed almost four million times and attracted thousands of comments with some doubting the result.

[3] “About 5000 people said it wasn’t true, I must have injected something into it and the rest of it, but I tell you what if you do it yourself you might blow numbers too,” Ms Jones said.

[4] [Perth company Breathalyser](https://breathalyser.com.au/) put the that claim to the test today and came up with similar results. Mark Ridley, of Breathalyser, explains why.

[5] “Ingesting food which has started to ferment, the raisins and fruit inside the buns, what it’s doing is creating mouth alcohol,” Mr Ridley said.

[6] Orange juice, mouth wash and breakfast drink UP&GO can have the same results. WA Police says its officers are trained to re-test people 20 minutes after a positive breath test and if all you have had is a hot cross bun the second test will register as zero.

[7] But if you have been drinking, best not to take the risk.

materials.content:
[1] The little buggers are in shops already, but can they get you in trouble behind the wheel?

[2] You might have seen the video of a WA truckdriver over Christmas, blowing a zero blood alcohol level, eating a hot cross bun, then blowing a 0.018.

[3] So what causes this and can hot cross buns put you over the driving limit? Ben & Liam got some answers from Academic Gastroenterologist Dr Vincent Ho, from the University of Western Sydney.

[4] “The spice flavouring has a bit of alcohol in it, and that can all be picked up, particularly by a breathalyser which picks up the presence of alcohol. Breathalysers can be quite sensitive.”

[5] Listen about to hear about the other foods that could have a similar effect. Read more [via ABC News](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-01-08/can-hot-cross-buns-produce-false-breathalyser-test/10698438) and remember kids, don’t hot cross bun and drive…..

[6] ☏ Hey guys! #bunsforlife But, I do know of someone who had a breathalyzer unit in their car and legitimately had their car lock on them mid drive and not let them go anywhere because they had eaten a hot cross bun while driving!!

[7] ☏ Truck drivers have to be 0.0, so a single hot crossed could cost them their job in theory. Harry from Prahran.

[8] ☏ That's all well and good but can we talk about fruitless hot cross buns and the sadistic f*cks that eat them? What sort of world do we live in where people get a kick out of eating fruitless hot cross buns….

[9] ☏ I'm on my P plates where the BAC has to be 0. No hot cross buns for me :( Annabelle Sydney

materials.content:
[1] MOTORISTS could find themselves hot water after enjoying a couple of hot cross buns, according to a new video.

[2] Just two of the Easter treats could give a false positive reading for alcohol in breath tests, even if the driver hasn’t touched a drop.

[3] An Aussie trucker demonstrated how the baked good affects breath readings in an online video.

[4] The woman first blew into a hand-held breathalyser and showed it produced a 0 blood alcohol level (BAL) reading as a control test.

[5] She then took a bite of a hot cross bun and tried the test again on the same machine.

[6] This time the screen showed a reading of 0.018 – meaning just two buns would probably produce a result of more than the UK legal limit of 0.08.

[7] She told followers of the Facebook page for female truckers in Western Australia: “So, be really careful this Easter.”

[8] Several other foods would also produce a reading like this, but return to zero a few moments later.

[9] A false positive would be quickly registered at the follow-up test at a police station, but could be an ordeal for an unsuspecting motorist.

[10] MOST READ IN WORLD NEWS

[11] The reading is given because the yeast used to make the buns turns into alcohol in the digestion process, and the fruit contains trace elements of alcohol.

[12] One commenter recalled how she was hauled down to the cop shop after eating a piece of tiramisu minutes before encountering police.

[13] She said: “I had literally just opened it and taken a mouthful before I came across the bus. It was still sitting on the seat.”
